==Instructions==
This template is to be used for the official [[StarWars.com]] blog. For the previous user blogs, use {{Tl|Blog}}

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{OfficialBlog|url=|text=|int=|quote=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

All fields need to be explicitly assigned to; otherwise, use of the "=" symbol in the URLs messes up the template.

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} The URL of the page, minus <code><nowiki>https://www.starwars.com/</nowiki></code>.
*{{Para|text}} The formatted text to display.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below. Note: the default values for dates are centralized at [[Module:ArchiveAccess/OfficialBlog]]. This template will use the default value when omitting <code>archivedate</code> or <code>archiveurl</code>, but either can be provided to override the default value.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|int}} This field provides a link to the [[Wookieepedia]] article, if one exists.
*{{Para|author}} Name(s) of the author(s). Multiple authors must be separated with a "<code>;</code>" between their names. Note that an author is not necessarily an individual and could be an organization. A long list of authors can be reduced using "<code>, et al.</code>" after the first name. Provide wikilinks whenever they are available.
*{{Para|date}} Full date of publication, in [[Wikipedia:ISO 8601|ISO 8601]] <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code> format, for example "<code>date=2006-02-17</code>".
*{{Para|quote}} Relevant quote from the blog page. Double-quotes will be added automatically.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{OfficialBlog|url=2008/05/30/well-miss-you-gormaanda|text=''We'll Miss You, Gormaanda''|date=2008-05-30|archivedate=20090825013717}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{OfficialBlog|url=2008/05/30/well-miss-you-gormaanda|text=''We'll Miss You, Gormaanda''|date=2008-05-30|archivedate=20090825013717}}
